package fixture

import "fmt"

const pw = "x1"

func viaConst(role string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`CREATE ROLE %q LOGIN PASSWORD '%s'`, role, pw)
}

func viaAssign(role string) string {
	secret := "x2"
	return fmt.Sprintf(`CREATE ROLE %q LOGIN PASSWORD '%s'`, role, secret)
}

func viaLiteral(role string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`CREATE ROLE %q LOGIN PASSWORD '%s'`, role, "x3")
}

func runtimeBuilt(role string) string {
	pass := build()
	return fmt.Sprintf(`CREATE ROLE %q LOGIN PASSWORD '%s'`, role, pass)
}

func build() string { return "" }
